:::{#exm-surprisal-rarity-four}
#### Surprisal and rarity of an outcome with probability one quarter

Take an [outcome](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-experiment-outcome) with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1/4$:

```{r}
#| label: surprisal-rarity-four
p_four <- 1 / 4
rarity_four <- 1 / p_four
surprisal_four <- log2(rarity_four)
surprisal_four
```

It has [rarity](#def-rarity) $`r rarity_four`$ by definition.
By @thm-surprisal-log-rarity, its [surprisal](#def-surprisal) is the base-2 logarithm of that rarity, $`r surprisal_four`$ [bits](#def-bit).

<!-- no-figure: a single closed-form value -->

:::
